build_metric: build a MetricCollection for a given MetricType like mean_accuracy with a specified number of classes
build_topk_accuracy_metric: build a top-k accuracy MetricCollection using micro, macro, or none averaging for multiclass classification
build_topk_imagenet_real_accuracy_metric: build a top-k ImageNet ReaL accuracy MetricCollection for real-world ImageNet evaluation with multiple targets
use_ImageNetReaLAccuracy_update: update the ImageNetReaLAccuracy metric with prediction tensors and multi-target label tensors
use_ImageNetReaLAccuracy_compute: compute the mean accuracy from accumulated true positives in the ImageNetReaLAccuracy metric
